coverage.target: DynamoDB strongly-consistent single-item ops + conditional UpdateItem ReturnValues:ALL_NEW (read-after-write, no extra read)

Lambda runtime runs the bounded ≤3 jittered retry for transient SDK errors only (throttling, 5xx, timeouts); a failed update condition is classified from ReturnValuesOnConditionCheckFailure ALL_OLD and never retried; 10s timeout sized above the retry budget
latencyMs capture is application logging code (observability), not an infra resource; surfaced via the CloudWatch latency metric filter
DynamoDB Scan with Limit and ExclusiveStartKey serving offset/limit pages; the 10000 offset cap bounds one request to at most 10100 items read; IAM grants dynamodb:Scan
numeric latency/throughput SLO deferred at MVP; CloudWatch captures latencyMs for a future target
AWS Lambda (stateless, per-request concurrency); all state in DynamoDB
DynamoDB atomic conditional UpdateItem with precomputed minCurrent/maxCurrent bounds (per-item concurrency at the datastore; no app locks)
DynamoDB partition key = sku (load spreads across SKUs); write-sharding noted as future, not built

Per-request list work is bounded by the offset cap (at most 10100 items read), but the total count Scan grows with table size; accepted for the MVP catalogue, with a maintained count item and cursor paging as the upgrade path
DynamoDB on-demand billing + Lambda scale-to-zero with reserved concurrency 50 as the hard cap
API Gateway + Lambda managed multi-AZ availability; availability SLI from API Gateway 5xx/Count (99.9%/30-day) in monitoring-design
correctness-under-failure is application logic (atomic update + fail-500-no-stale); infra contributes PITR durability (NFR1.14) only
Lambda replaces failed execution environments automatically; a Synthetics canary on GET /v1/health detects an unhealthy service (API Gateway does no health checks on a Lambda integration)
DynamoDB managed multi-AZ durability + point-in-time recovery + encryption at rest + deletion protection
graceful failure / SIGTERM drain is application runtime behaviour; Lambda shutdown hook is the platform touchpoint, no dedicated resource
numeric RTO/MTTR deferred; mechanisms (auto-replace, managed durability) are NFR1.13/1.14
boundary input validation is application handler code, not infrastructure
error-envelope / no-leakage is application middleware code, not infrastructure

Superseded by the Contract Design auth decision (Q7): API Gateway HTTP API JWT authorizer on every /v1 item route, issuer = Cognito user pool inventory-api-users, audience = its no-secret app client; GET /v1/health open; Lambda holds no inbound surface
The reserved auth seam is now used: HTTP API JWT authorizer returns 401 with the gateway body before the Lambda runs (no handler change), replacing the planned X-Api-Key
TLS 1.2+ terminated at API Gateway HTTP API; no plaintext listener
GET /v1/health route (no authorizer) on API Gateway -> Lambda live alias; probed every 5 minutes by a CloudWatch Synthetics canary and by the CI smoke test
structured-log field set is application logger code; infra provides the CloudWatch Logs sink (NFR3.7)
requestId generation/correlation is application middleware code; infra provides log queryability (NFR3.7)
no-sensitive-data log allow-list is application logger code, not infrastructure
GET /v1/health -> 200 {status:ok}; target of the Synthetics canary that drives the Health failing alert
CloudWatch alarm on API Gateway 5xx/Count > ~1% over 5 min with a low floor -> SNS (ticket, page if sustained); counts Lambda timeouts, crashes and throttles too
CloudWatch Logs group per environment, 30-day retention; structured JSON lines + JSON API Gateway access logs (covers 401s rejected by the JWT authorizer)
dedicated emitted metrics deferred; service metrics derived from logs via CloudWatch metric filters, error rate from API Gateway metrics (monitoring-design)
distributed tracing deferred (single service); X-Ray enablement path noted in monitoring-design for a future multi-service topology
Secrets Manager / SSM Parameter Store injected at deploy time; CI OIDC role (no long-lived keys); smoke-test user password in Secrets Manager; no secrets in source/artifact
CI pipeline: gitleaks (secret scan) + Dependabot/npm audit (dependency scan) as merge-blocking gates; cdk-nag Errors gate with in-code justified suppressions
